# Protocol v5 (WireGoldenTest). The batch after 2026-09-29 adds its messages
# here; once it is released, never edit these lines: a wire change is then protocol 6, with its own golden-v6.txt.
# Lines: <kind> <name> <value>; kinds msg (frame hex), type (code), enum (values in wire order), cap, payload.
